mechanism: Fluphenazine may increase levothyroxine metabolism via CYP1A2 induction and reduce GI absorption, potentially decreasing thyroid hormone levels; conversely, excessive thyroid hormone can potentiate antipsychotic-induced cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor TSH levels closely when initiating or discontinuing fluphenazine; adjust levothyroxine dose as needed and monitor for signs of hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism.
